project.description: The project this object belongs to.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

title:
Job to distribute {@link MlModel#process} over many subjects and time ranges.

The computations are done on a group of {@link MlSubject}s defined by a {@link Filter} and a
{@link TimeRange time range} (if applicable).
The job creates {@link MlSubject.Batch batches} of subjects and can optionally split the time range into slices.
This is sometimes needed when predictions are made over a large time range and the input data do not fit in a
single node's memory (even for 1 subject).

Example usage:
```py
>>> project = c3.MlProject(...)
>>> model = c3.MlModel(project=project, ...)
>>> model.deploy()
>>> job_spec = c3.MlSubject.OperationJobSpec(
...     subjectFilter="country == 'USA'",
...     start="2020-01-01",
...     end="2020-01-03",
...     batchInterval=c3.Interval.DAY,
...     project=project
... )
>>> job = c3.MlSubject.ProcessJob(project=project).upsert()
>>> job.start(job_spec)
```
name: MlSubject.ProcessJob
